positions.name: DirectiveMemoryErasure
positions.frame: How does the speaker exercise authority through directives to discard or remove shared knowledge?
positions.why: Both expressions are unhedged imperative directives commanding the erasure of institutional knowledge — one to 'forget' a prior decision, the other to 'remove all knowledge' of a migration. They share the same authority-ranking stance, calm-negative affect, and decision-grade conviction, cohering under a single read of unilateral knowledge erasure enacted through positional authority.
